The '''Qixoni Nebula''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="Southern Core" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] shared its name with the [[Qixoni crystal/Legends|Qixoni crystals]], a type of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] that had formed on a [[Unidentified planet (Qixoni crystals)|planet]] before its [[Star/Legends|star]] exploded as a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] and destroyed it [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', which includes an appearance of the [[Qixoni crystal/Legends|Qixoni crystals]], to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> during the time of some of the first [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="KOTOR2" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Qixoni Nebula was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13. The book also placed the nebula in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], despite grid square K-13 not intersecting the region.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' later corrected the placement by establishing that the Qixoni Nebula lay in the Colonies instead.<ref name="EAOC" />
